data.description:
## Description
**What**: Implement plugins/dso/hooks/check-hermeticity.sh as a thin wrapper over static-defense-lib.sh that detects $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT (and equivalent plugin-root variables) referenced unbound under `set -u`, ships its initial per-hook baseline, and registers in .pre-commit-config.yaml between shellcheck and pre-commit-review-gate.
**Why**: The unbound-$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT chain recurred across fe45-0b58, 09d8-11f0, 82ad-7bb3, and 97a7-4504 over months; a dedicated hermeticity gate stops the chain.
**Scope**:
- IN: the hook, its detection logic, its initial baseline, its .pre-commit-config.yaml entry, and its fixture + end-to-end test.
- OUT: remediation of existing unbound-root sites; the shared library functions (consumed from draft-1).

## Done Definitions

- check-hermeticity.sh blocks a commit when staged content references $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT unbound under set -u ← Satisfies: sc-1
- check-hermeticity.sh reads its per-hook count-based baseline so captured existing violations do not block while a new instance beyond the baseline is blocked ← Satisfies: sc-2
- check-hermeticity.sh emits a per-file diagnostic naming the offending line, the remediation string, and the originating-ticket citation ← Satisfies: sc-3
- check-hermeticity.sh honors a non-empty `# antipattern-ok: <reason>` suppression and rejects an empty or whitespace-only suppression reason ← Satisfies: sc-5
- a fixture test asserts detection on staged content, baselined-violation non-firing, new-instance blocking, and baseline-growth rejection; an end-to-end test invokes the hook through the real pre-commit framework and the hook resolves its own path and baseline without CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and passes its own check (dogfood) ← Satisfies: sc-6
- check-hermeticity.sh executes under a bash-3.2-constrained test that passes ← Satisfies: sc-8
- unit tests (fixture-based) are written and passing for all new detection logic in check-hermeticity.sh ← Satisfies: sc-1

## Considerations

- [Hermeticity] The hook MUST resolve its own path and baseline via BASH_SOURCE -> readlink -f, never CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT.
- [Build] check-hermeticity.sh and its new test files must have the executable bit set.
- [Merge-safety] Register as a discrete, independently-named entry in the shellcheck-to-pre-commit-review-gate band.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a committing developer, I want check-hermeticity.sh to block staged scripts that reference $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT unbound under set -u, so that the recurring unbound-root failure class is caught at commit time.
